key_insight: β-OPSD reframes on-policy self-distillation as policy optimization with a tunable KL anchor, then uses the closed-form solution as an efficient distillation target.
engineering_relevance: This gives practitioners a simple knob to trade off stability and teacher guidance, reducing the brittle tuning and engineering overhead of vanilla OPSD.
method: Introduce β as a controllable KL-regularization weight in the OPSD objective.
Derive the optimal policy as a geometric interpolation between the reference policy and the privileged teacher.
Approximate the RL optimum by mixing token-level logits and apply return-to-go credit assignment for sequence-level alignment.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks where β-OPSD consistently improves both optimization stability and downstream reasoning performance over vanilla OPSD.
watch_item: The method still depends on careful selection of β and on efficient, correct implementation of the logit-mixing and return-to-go training pipeline.
paper_title: $β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation
